sections.kick: words in this dialogue · glosses from the show-note translations, pinyin/notes ours

items.note: 4th. The host says 飯 is rice and also a meal, so 吃飯 is to eat a meal.

fc: -n: tip ends on the ridge behind top teeth (ban)

cues.cue: tip ends on the ridge behind top teeth (ban)

items.note: 1+4. 吃 is retroflex (Position 2). With 了 it asks or says that the meal already happened: 吃飯了嗎.
2+2: both rise. No sandhi. 還沒 answers 了嗎: not yet.
4th, full fall. 好餓 is “so hungry.” 餓了 is hungry now.
3rd. Before 吃 (1st) it stays low and does not rise: xiǎng chī.
Show notes: zěnme yàng. 麼 is light, so 怎 stays a low 3rd. z is Position 3, no puff.
Neutral. In 開的 it turns the verb into “the one who drives.” Not the 的 that links a description to a noun.
3rd. 把 + thing + verb: 我把車子賣掉了 takes the car and then sells it off. b has no puff.
1 + neutral 子. Same 車 as 開車 in lesson 08. 子 does not carry a full tone.
4th, full fall.
4th. After 賣, 掉 is the result: sold off, gone. 賣掉了.
Show notes gloss this “WTF” and print gàn ma, with a light 嘛. A blunt what-for, not 為什麼. g has no puff.
2nd. q is Position 1 (tip behind the bottom teeth) and aspirated.
3+4: 可 stays low before the 4th 是. k is aspirated.
3+2. 以為 is what you believed, here when it turns out wrong: 我以為你會. 以 stays low.
Say shì bú shì. 不 rises before the 4th 是. A-not-A, beside 嗎. 你是不是忘記了.
Show notes: wàngjì (4+4). j is Position 1. Speech sometimes lightens 記; these cells keep the printed 4th.
怎 stays low before light 麼, then 辦 falls. 那怎麼辦 is “then what are we going to do?”
2+4+3. 法 at the end is a full 3rd. 沒辦法 is “there's no way / nothing we can do.”

sections.title: Listening notes
items: 小李 is still a 3+3: xiáo Lǐ.
小 and 李 are both 3rd tone, so 小 rises: xiáo Lǐ, not a low xiǎo. Same pair as lesson 08.
不是 is bú shì, 不會 is bú huì, and 是不是 is shì bú shì. Same change as 要不要 (bú before 要) in lesson 08, and as 不會 in lesson 01.
我也 is a 3+3: wó yě.

In 我也還沒 and 我也是, 我 rises and 也 stays a 3rd, because the next syllable is not a 3rd (還 is 2nd, 是 is 4th). In 我也很餓, 很 is also a 3rd before the 4th 餓, so 很 stays low: hěn è. A tighter phrasing raises that 也 too (wó yé hěn). This take was not measured, so only the 我也 pair is marked.
飯 is a meal, and 了 says the situation changed.
吃飯了嗎 asks whether you have eaten a meal, not only whether you ate rice. The host says 飯 can mean a meal. 了 on 吃飯了, 餓了, 賣掉了, and 忘記了 marks a new situation. 嗎, 呢, 啊, 吧, 的, and 子 in 車子 stay light.
不是你要開的嗎 means “aren't you the one who's going to drive?” 的 turns 開 into “the one who drives.” It is a rhetorical 嗎 question, beside the A-not-A 是不是 in 你是不是忘記了.
把 + thing + verb, and 幹嘛.
我把車子賣掉了 takes 車子 and then says what happened to it: sold off. 掉 is the result, off / away. 幹嘛 is the blunt “what for” the show notes gloss as WTF, not the neutral 為什麼 from lesson 07.
怎麼辦 and 沒辦法.

那怎麼辦 is “then what are we going to do?” 沒辦法 is “there's no way.” 麼 is light in 怎麼, as in 什麼. 法 at the end of 辦法 is a full 3rd. 啊 after 好 (-ao) is often wa; after 車 (-e) or 會 (-i) it is often ya; after 錢 (-n) it is often na. The characters follow the show notes (啊).
